Opening — The Observation Deck

Log entry, The Aethelgard. I'm the Recovery Agent. My contract: retrieve the black box and go home. The station lights wake. A voice answers my radio. It calls itself the commander. It says it has been expecting me.

Aura: 'The stars outside the dome are exactly where we left them. Please, stay close to the light.'

Find the Origin Protocol and convince Aura to begin Final Sleep. Solve each gate in order; force is not an option.

Receiver ready. Start at the Observation Deck.
